inlines.v: SEEL, v. t. To close the eyes; a term of falconry, from the practice of the closing the eyes of a wild hawk. SEEL, v. i. [See Sell.] To lean ; to incline to one side. Obs. SEEL, noun. The rolling or agitation of a ship in a storm. Obs.
